description: This file defines the Currency class within the OpenCart admin controller event namespace, responsible for attaching a task to generate currency data during certain triggers. It includes a method to add a currency-related task via the model, with some commented-out legacy code.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: A controller class handling event-driven task addition for currency data in the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Adds a task for generating new currency data when triggered by certain events within the admin interface.
